API Connections
C
Claude AI (Anthropic)
Powers all four agents — PR, Marketing, Sales, Brand
Not set
Get a key at console.anthropic.com →
S
Shopify
Live order data, revenue, customer info, inventory sync
Not set
The Admin token lives server-side only — it never enters this browser. In Netlify → Site configuration → Environment variables add SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN (e.g. veniacollection.myshopify.com) and SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN (the shpat_… token from Admin → Apps → Develop apps), then redeploy and test. The app reads orders through a server proxy that only ever performs read-only requests.
S
Stripe
Deposits & card holds for stylist pulls — payment links from the Finish Checkout sheet
Not tested
The secret key lives server-side only: Netlify → Site configuration → Environment variables → add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (from dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys), then redeploy and test.
G
Google — Calendar & Sign-in
Plan your day around real events & sign in with Google
Not set
Google Cloud → APIs & Services → Clients → create a Web application client with authorized JS origin https://creator.veniacollection.com. Enable the Calendar API and add the calendar.events scope (read + write, so the planner can add events). This ID is public (safe in the browser).
N
News API
Press scan — monitors news sources for VENIA mentions
Not set
Free at newsapi.org → — 100 req/day on free tier
IG
Instagram / Meta
Read DMs, monitor mentions, track engagement — @veniacollection
Not set
developers.facebook.com → Create App → Business → Instagram Graph API →
S
Stripe
Pull fee invoicing & hold charges
Not set
dashboard.stripe.com → Developers → API keys →

Quick Actions

PRESS RELEASE
Celebrity PR Package
Name a celebrity who wore VENIA. Agent writes: press release, 3 editor pitches, social captions, and audience email — all in one shot.
SYSTEM
Moment Capture Checklist
The 24-hour playbook for when a celebrity wears VENIA. What to post, who to email, which editors to pitch, in what order.
OUTREACH
Music Press Hit List
Name an artist from VENIA's client list. Agent builds the 10 media contacts who cover that artist's world and would care about VENIA dressing them.
EMAIL
Audience Announcement
Draft an email to VENIA's audience about a celebrity placement. Specific, short, with a clear CTA that converts curiosity into traffic.
SOCIAL
Social Push Strategy
Turn a celebrity moment into a social media push. Agent writes captions, suggests tags, timing, and a 3-post sequence for IG + TikTok.
FIND
Next Target Artist
Given VENIA's aesthetic and client history, which 5 artists should we actively pursue for placements next? Agent identifies fit, approach, and contact.

Ready to Scan
Hold an NFC-tagged sample near your device's reader. The style will be identified automatically and added to the pull or checked back in.
iPhone? You don't need this screen — just tap the phone on the garment tag. Tags carry a URL (…/?tag=STY001, see 🏷 Tag URLs) that opens VENIA and logs check-out / check-in against the working pull automatically. This live scanner is for Android Chrome only.
